skills.name: Advanced Static Malware Analysis
skills.lab_title: Advanced Static Malware Analysis Using PEStudio
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to advanced static malware analysis using PEStudio, a widely used tool for initial triage of suspicious PE files.

skills.name: Anti-Analysis Techniques
skills.description: This lab focuses on advanced anti-analysis techniques used by malware authors to evade detection and hinder reverse engineering.

skills.name: Apache Access Log Analysis
skills.description: This lab focuses on understanding the Apache Access Combined log format, one of the most common web server log formats used in security monitoring.

skills.name: API & Modern Application Security
skills.description: In this lab, you will step into the role of an attacker analyzing modern applications and APIs for common security misconfigurations.

skills.name: Windows API Monitoring
skills.description: Windows API monitoring involves tracking interactions between applications and the operating system to detect suspicious behavior.

skills.name: Malware Behavior Monitoring
skills.description: In this lab, we learn how to monitor and analyze the behavior of malware during execution to understand its capabilities and intentions.

skills.name: Binary Forensic Analysis
skills.description: A member of your company's finance team has reported that their workstation began behaving strangely. Investigate the binary artifacts.

skills.name: Broken Authentication
skills.description: This lab simulates an internal employee web portal that implements authentication and access controls with common vulnerabilities.

skills.name: Broken Authentication - Identity Failures
skills.lab_title: Broken Authentication - Identity and Session Failures
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to Broken Authentication, a critical vulnerability in web applications that can lead to identity and session management failures.

skills.name: Broken Authentication Logic Flaws
skills.description: This lab demonstrates a broken authentication logic flaw in a web application where access controls can be circumvented.

skills.name: CIDR & Subnetting
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to CIDR (Classless Inter-Domain Routing) and subnetting fundamentals for network segmentation.

skills.name: Command Injection
skills.description: This lab introduces Command Line Injection, one of the most common and dangerous web application vulnerabilities allowing OS command execution.

skills.name: Data Carving and File Recovery
skills.description: This lab introduces players to the fundamentals of digital forensics using X-Ways, Autopsy, and Scalpel for data carving and recovering deleted files.

skills.name: Deceptive Delivery Analysis
skills.description: The lab is for analyzing suspicious executables in an isolated environment to understand malware delivery mechanisms.

skills.name: SIEM Log Types & Formats
skills.lab_title: Different Types of Logs in SIEM and Their Log Formats
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to the different types of logs used in SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) and their standard formats.

skills.name: Network Anomaly Detection
skills.lab_title: Echo in Memory: The Outbound Anomaly
skills.description: On an otherwise routine Monday morning, the internal security monitoring team at your organization detected an anomalous outbound connection.

skills.name: Steganography & Hidden Data
skills.description: A mysterious hacker group known as 'The Silent Frequency' has been leaking classified information using hidden communication channels.

skills.name: Encoding & Cryptographic Forensics
skills.description: A short, beginner-friendly crypto/forensics-style challenge where contestants must decode encoded messages to uncover hidden secrets.

skills.name: File Structure Analysis
skills.description: Static malware analysis involves examining a suspicious file's structure and contents without executing it to identify indicators of compromise.

skills.name: Linux File & Directory Management
skills.description: This lab introduces us to essential Linux file and directory management commands used in forensic investigations.

skills.name: Security Foundations & Attacker Mindset
skills.description: Learn the foundational concepts of cybersecurity and develop an attacker's mindset to think like an adversary.

skills.name: Internet Protocol Fundamentals
skills.description: This lab covers the fundamentals of Internet Protocol (IP), including addressing, routing, and packet structure.

skills.name: GitHub Reconnaissance
skills.description: Learn techniques for gathering intelligence from GitHub repositories, including exposed secrets, API keys, and sensitive configuration files.

skills.name: Google Dorking
skills.description: Learn advanced Google search operators (dorks) to discover exposed sensitive files, login portals, and misconfigured web servers.

skills.name: Hidden Artifact Discovery
skills.description: A notorious cyber criminal known only as 'The Whisper' has been secretly leaking sensitive data. Uncover hidden forensic artifacts.

skills.name: Host-Based Incident Response
skills.description: GTS's network monitoring detected a brief, unauthorized outbound network connection from a workstation. Respond and investigate the host.

skills.name: HTTP Protocol Deep Dive
skills.description: This lab provides a detailed exploration of HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol), the foundation of web communication.

skills.name: Linux Input/Output Handling
skills.description: This lab introduces standard input, output, and error in Linux and explains how to redirect and pipe data between commands.

skills.name: IDOR Vulnerability Exploitation
skills.description: This lab focuses on a Broken Access Control issue in an API-based application. The application exposes Insecure Direct Object References.

skills.name: IDOR - Broken Object Level Authorization
skills.lab_title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - Broken Object Level Authorization
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR), a common vulnerability where user-controlled input references objects directly.

skills.name: Computer Networking Basics
skills.description: A computer network is a group of devices connected to share data and resources. Learn the fundamental building blocks of networking.

skills.name: Linux, GNU and Interfaces
skills.lab_title: Introduction to Linux, GNU and Interfaces
skills.description: This lab introduces us to the fundamental idea about Linux. It covers basic ideas such as the Linux kernel, GNU tools, and desktop interfaces.

skills.name: Introduction to Static Malware Analysis
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to Static Malware Analysis, a foundational technique for examining suspicious files without execution.

skills.name: OSI Model Understanding
skills.description: Understand the seven layers of the OSI Model (Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application).

skills.name: Threat Modelling Fundamentals
skills.description: Learn how attackers think before they attack! This lab introduces the core concepts of threat modelling including STRIDE and DREAD frameworks.

skills.name: Kali Linux Environment Setup
skills.description: This guide explains step-by-step how to download and install Kali Linux in Oracle VirtualBox for penetration testing.

skills.name: Linux Links & Symlinks
skills.description: In the Linux ecosystem, a file isn't just a collection of data; it's an entry in the file system. Learn about hard links and symbolic links.

skills.name: Linux Distributions Overview
skills.description: This lab introduces you to Linux distributions and explains why different distributions exist for different use cases.

skills.name: Linux File Systems
skills.description: This lab introduces you to Linux file system. You get a clear idea about how files and directories are organized in Linux.

skills.name: Linux Live Forensic Analysis
skills.description: You are doing SOC Monitoring for BlackPerl and in your Splunk you have seen an alert indicating suspicious activity on a Linux host.

skills.name: Linux Permission System
skills.description: This Lab provides a comprehensive guide to the Linux Permission System, the foundation of access control in Linux environments.

skills.name: Container Security Analysis
skills.description: An attacker compromised LORA Clothing's production server, but the SOC team was able to capture the container for analysis.

skills.name: Log Correlation & Pivoting
skills.description: An unknown attacker entered the main server of EchoWave Post Production Pvt Lt. Correlate and pivot across multiple log sources.

skills.name: Memory Forensics & Analysis
skills.description: Detective Analyst Sarah sighed, looking at the blinking alert on her screen. Another suspicious memory dump to analyze.

skills.name: Metadata Forensic Investigation
skills.description: A famous wildlife photographer, Rahul, recently went missing during his solo expedition. Follow the metadata trail to find clues.

skills.name: Windows Artifact Timeline Reconstruction
skills.description: This lab focuses on Windows artifact analysis and timeline reconstruction. You'll analyze prefetch, shimcache, and amcache artifacts.

skills.name: Digital Forensics Investigation
skills.description: In this lab, you'll step into the role of a digital forensics intern at ICFI investigating a case of missing examination files.

skills.name: NAT & Address Translation
skills.description: This lab introduces learners to Network Address Translation (NAT) concepts used in modern networking infrastructure.

skills.name: SIEM Alert Investigation
skills.description: In this lab, you will analyze Sysmon logs within an Elastic SIEM environment to investigate a Notepad++ compromise.

skills.name: Malware Obfuscation Techniques
skills.description: In this lab, you will encounter a malicious binary designed to evade basic static analysis through various obfuscation techniques.

skills.name: Penetration Testing Basics
skills.description: In this lab, you will step into the shoes of an entry-level penetration tester to master the fundamental methodology of pentesting.

skills.name: Persistence Mechanism Detection
skills.description: On an otherwise routine Monday morning, the internal security monitoring team at your organization detected suspicious persistence mechanisms.

skills.name: Advanced Threat Investigation
skills.description: A sophisticated threat actor has infiltrated a financial system. Hunt through logs and artifacts to uncover the phantom ledger.

skills.name: Privilege Escalation Techniques
skills.description: Privilege Escalation usually involves going from a lower permission account to a higher permission account by exploiting vulnerabilities.

skills.name: Process Injection Analysis
skills.description: Process Injection is a cybersecurity technique where malware inserts malicious code into a legitimate running process.

skills.name: Runtime Investigation & Analysis
skills.description: QuickClean Pro is a free system optimization tool that claims to clean caches, but exhibits suspicious runtime behavior.

skills.name: Race Condition Exploitation
skills.description: Bypass techniques in cybersecurity refer to methods used to circumvent security controls through race condition vulnerabilities.

skills.name: Web Reconnaissance Techniques
skills.description: In this lab, you'll explore reconnaissance techniques used to gather information about target web applications and infrastructure.

skills.name: Sandbox-Based Malware Analysis
skills.description: In this dynamic analysis lab, you will learn how to safely handle and analyze a suspicious file using sandbox environments.

skills.name: Server Side Template Injection
skills.description: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) is a web vulnerability that occurs when user-controlled input is embedded into server-side templates.

target_roles.name: SOC Analyst (L1/L2)
target_roles.description: Monitors security events, triages SIEM alerts, deconstructs phishing emails, and executes automated response playbooks.

target_roles.name: Penetration Tester / Red Teamer
target_roles.description: Assesses web applications, Active Directory domain infrastructure, and executes red team operations.

target_roles.name: DFIR Specialist
target_roles.description: Responds to enterprise breaches, analyzes disk images & RAM dumps, and reconstructs incident timelines.

target_roles.name: Threat Hunter
target_roles.description: Proactively searches enterprise telemetry for hidden adversary TTPs, C2 beacons, and evasive persistence.

target_roles.name: Malware Analyst & Reverse Engineer
target_roles.description: Decompiles binary malware samples, unpacks protected executables, and extracts C2 infrastructure indicators.
